hypothesis: Alpha-enabling measurement repair: experiment.py new can still burn duplicate IDs when an identical reserve is retried before the first ticket is visible to the in-flight duplicate guard; add a fingerprint-keyed reservation intent lock so same-proposal concurrent or retry calls return the first open ticket instead of allocating another ID, without changing strategy behavior.
notes: Accepted measurement repair only.
